title: Correct current magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate I₁ = mg/(B₁L) = 0.2 A.

title: Correct current direction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the current flows from c to d, using the left-hand rule.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply equilibrium (Ampere force = weight) for part (1) when tension is zero.

title: Correct tension magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate F₂ = mg + B₂I₂L = 0.3 N for part (2).

title: Force direction analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the Ampere force direction (upward/downward) for each scenario using the left-hand rule.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should convert mass to kg and length to m before calculation.

title: Sign error in force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds/subtracts forces in part (2), e.g., using F = mg - BIL.

title: Direction rule confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses the right-hand rule instead of the left-hand rule for motor effect.
